appraisal_events.evidence: se précipitant sur un livre de messe... commençait à lire au plus vite les textes sacrés dont l'intelligence lui était légèrement obscurcie par l'incertitude de savoir si... la pepsine serait encore capable de la rattraper et de la faire descendre
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator ironically shows tante Léonie's panicked, self-absorbed preoccupation with her digestion overriding her attention to the sacred texts she is nominally reading, casting her as comically hypochondriac rather than devout.

status_effects.explanation: The ironic juxtaposition of her feigned religious urgency with her actual bodily obsession locally lowers how she is regarded, in keeping with the passage's comic framing of her self-centered hypochondria.
